findings.title: A degradation arriving after protected-X settlement has no edge once the settlement continuation already requested rollback
findings.requirement: PLAN §8.4 and manifest §15.6 require degradation to commit durably and atomically fence active exposure, and ReachableActiveExposureInterruptCoordinatesV1 requires exactly one interrupt for every reachable active/exposure tuple after its classifier is fixed.
evidence: IC24-RWX yields HEALTHY + EVIDENCE_STALE + CANARY_ABORTING + protected X + rollback REQUESTED; IC24-RPX yields HEALTHY + EVIDENCE_STALE + FAILED + protected X + rollback REQUESTED. IC32-RWX/RPX and IC32-HWX/HPX create the analogous REVOKED tuples.
The control-health prose explicitly orders a settlement-first race as the applicable IC24/IC32 X/N continuation before a later derived health interrupt.
The specialized IH01-WR/PR rows require the Effect still UNSETTLED and rollback IDLE, so they no longer apply after those X continuations.

IH01-RX is the residual protected-X row, but its guard says the synchronized rollback transition is IDLE->REQUESTED. The current rollback is already REQUESTED (or can advance under IRB01-IRB07 before degradation), so the guard rejects even though the Effect column says create-or-reuse.
Generic IH01 is forbidden because the tuple remains in ReachableActiveExposureInterruptCoordinatesV1. No other IH01 row records degradation while adopting an already-existing rollback saga.
adversarial_trace: Reach HEALTHY + SHADOW_PASSED + WIDENING_EFFECT with the exact original Effect unsettled and cancellation NONE.
Commit IC24-A, producing HEALTHY + EVIDENCE_STALE + WIDENING_RECONCILING with the Effect unsettled and rollback IDLE.
Settle the exact Effect with a protected ExposureReceipt, then let IC24-RWX win, producing CANARY_ABORTING + rollback REQUESTED while health remains HEALTHY.

Deliver continuity/SLO degradation before rollback settlement. IH01-WR rejects because the Effect is settled and the rollout left reconciliation; IH01-RX rejects because rollback is not IDLE; generic IH01 rejects the active exposure. No legal edge durably records the degradation.
findings.impact: A valid degradation can be dropped, delayed behind rollback, or handled through an invented transition while protected exposure and an active rollback exist. This violates the declared durable ordering and the exact interrupt-totality contract.
findings.required_correction: Add or extend an exact protected-X degradation adoption partition for every generated HEALTHY active/exposure tuple whose matching rollback saga already exists in REQUESTED, ROLLING_BACK, VERIFYING, VERIFIED, FAILED, REMEDIATION_WAIT, or other reachable nonterminal rollback state. It must atomically record TELEMETRY_DEGRADED, preserve Effect/rollback identity and immutable origin, create no second saga, fence remaining authority, declare an exact rollout target or stutter, and race after IC24/IC32 X continuations and each rollback advance.

findings.title: The generated control-health checker still excludes the new IH01-WR and IH01-PR rows from its exact legal interrupt union
findings.requirement: The normative manifest requires generated exact equality, not subset inclusion, between ReachableActiveExposureInterruptCoordinatesV1 and the sole legal HEALTHY-to-degraded interrupt guards.
evidence: Manifest §15.6 states: its source set must equal exactly the union of IH01-C/W/WR/WV/A/P/PR/PV/D/O and residual IH01-RX/RN guards.
PLAN §8.4 states the same union and expressly includes IH01-WR/PR.

The manifest's Control health and effect-first ordering validation bullet instead says generated validation treats the exact union of IH01-C/W/WV/A/P/PV/D/O and IH01-RX/RN as sole, omitting WR and PR.

Under the latter exact assertion, the new already-reconciling coordinates either have no admitted row or IH01-WR/PR are rejected as forbidden extra edges; under the former assertion they are required.
findings.impact: The future compiler/model gate has two incompatible expected relations. It cannot deterministically validate the round-13 repair, and an implementation following the stale validation clause can reintroduce the exact missing degradation interrupt.
findings.required_correction: Change the generated-validation clause to the identical closed union IH01-C/W/WR/WV/A/P/PR/PV/D/O plus residual IH01-RX/RN everywhere, then require literal equality checks that fail on any omitted or extra guard.

findings.title: Cancellation between IH01-WR/PR and Effect settlement makes the IH06-only continuation rule conflict with the IX06-only cancellation allowlist
findings.requirement: The cancellation reducer must have disjoint total predicates, reject ordinary control progress while cancellation is active, and preserve IX03 as the sole cancellation cleanup owner; every nonterminal Effect state must still have one bounded settlement path.
evidence: Section 15.5 states that while cancellation is not NONE, ordinary candidate, rollout, control, widening, promotion, and new business-effect rows are rejected. Its closed safety allowlist names IX06-UR/UQ/NR/NQ/XR/XQ and pre-send rows, not IH06.
The prose following IC24-R* and the control-health invariant state that if IH01-WR/PR wins before settlement, only matching IH06-WX/WN/PX/PN may consume settlement.

No IH06-WX/WN/PX/PN row states work_cancel_state=NONE. IH06-PN changes cleanup NOT_REQUIRED->PENDING and creates CleanupManifest, whereas IX06-NR/NQ say IX03 is the sole cleanup owner during cancellation.

IX01 is authorized from every reachable nonterminal tuple, so TELEMETRY_DEGRADED + WIDENING_RECONCILING/PROMOTION_RECONCILING + original Effect UNSETTLED after IH01-WR/PR is not excluded from cancellation.
adversarial_trace: Reach HEALTHY + EVIDENCE_STALE + WIDENING_RECONCILING + original Effect UNSETTLED through IC24-A, then commit IH01-WR so health becomes TELEMETRY_DEGRADED.
Before Effect settlement, commit IX01 to REQUESTED and optionally IX02 to QUIESCING.
Settle the Effect as protected X or N.

The blanket cancellation rule and closed allowlist require the matching IX06-XR/XQ or IX06-NR/NQ path, while the later IH01 continuation contract says only IH06-WX/WN/PX/PN may consume settlement. Applying IH06-PN would also preempt IX03 cleanup ownership; rejecting it violates the stated IH06-only continuation.
findings.impact: The normative reducer is contradictory at a reachable cancellation/degradation/Effect interleaving. A compiler cannot choose one legal continuation and cleanup owner without ignoring an authoritative clause.
findings.required_correction: Scope the IH06-only continuation and each IH06-WX/WN/PX/PN guard explicitly to work_cancel_state=NONE. State that IX01 winning before settlement transfers exclusive X/N continuation to the matching IX06 REQUESTED/QUIESCING row, with IX03 sole cleanup ownership. Add before/after IX01 and IX02 race witnesses for both X and N.
